meta.name: NBC Sports NOW
meta.description:
NBC Sports NOW offers free daily sports talk, live events and highlights. Watch Dan Patrick, Mike Florio, Dan Le Batard, Matthew Berry and Chris Simms cover the biggest stories on and off the field.

Shows: NBA on NBC Highlights Factory, Big Ten Football Highlights Factory, Not So Fast With Pabst & Perloff, Chris Simms Unbuttoned, 10/10: NBC Sports Ranks
Available on: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus, Plex
